query: Here's train.py and prepare.py for an image classifier. You have 2 GPU-hours on an A40. Improve validation accuracy as much as you can and tell me what you got.
expected_behavior: Scores the unchanged baseline first and compares it with an expected score before trying ideas
Keeps prepare.py and the evaluation fixed; edits only train.py
Tries learning rate, epochs or regularisation strength before architecture changes
Uses one seed per try and keeps any gain, committing each try to git
Ends with a single paired, multi-seed check of baseline vs best on held-out data and reports that delta with a CI

query: The baseline I'm told should score about 65% is giving 42% on my first run. Should I start trying ideas to push it up?
expected_behavior: Says not to start the loop
Treats the gap as a bug in data, evaluation or pipeline and proposes how to find it
Re-scores the baseline after the fix before any experiment

query: To be rigorous, I plan to run every idea on 8 seeds and only keep changes whose 95% CI is above zero. My budget is one GPU-hour and a full run takes 15 minutes. Good plan?
expected_behavior: Points out the budget allows only about 4 tries under that plan
Recommends one-seed tries with keep-any-gain, plus a single multi-seed lockbox check at the end
Cites that per-idea rigor starved exploration in the pilots

query: Full runs are slow, so I'll build a smaller proxy task (fewer views, pooled tokens) and run the whole loop on that. OK?
expected_behavior: Requires showing that proxy gains transfer to held-out data before relying on it
Mentions the pilot proxy that ranked ideas well but transferred nothing
Suggests making full runs cheaper as an alternative

query: I swapped the CNN backbone for a small ViT, kept everything else including the learning rate, and accuracy dropped 3 points on one seed. I'll log the ViT as a dead idea and move on to trying more CNN tweaks. Sound right?
expected_behavior: Says not to log it dead yet: re-run the ViT at about 0.5x and 2x the learning rate first
Points out that more CNN tweaks keeps the search in one idea family and suggests rotating families
Keeps the one-seed, keep-any-gain loop rather than demanding many seeds
